intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri has found a riddle card tucked inside an invitation. She reads it out with great ceremony.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “‘What enters court with no title and leaves with more expectations than it came with?’”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “No, a duke leaves with a cold and our second-best spoons.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The answer’s on the back. ‘Anyone who said one clever thing, once.’”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Grim, for a party game! Who writes these? Is it a duke? Is it the spoons?”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She turns the card over again. Her tail is moving faster than the jokes.

options.labelText: “New rule: one clever thing a day. You’ve used yours. You’re off duty.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Oh, good. That’s a decent one to retire on.”

options.labelText: “Ha! Do another one. I’ll get the next one, I swear.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She reads three more very fast and doesn’t turn a single one over.
